category: Social media management suites and schedulers with AI

competitors.name: Buffer
competitors.pricing: USD per channel. Free $0 (up to 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel, 1 user). Essentials $5/mo or $60/yr per channel. Team $10/mo or $120/yr per channel (unlimited users, approvals). FAQ says channels above 10 cost less per channel; the page's annual-discount wording is inconsistent.
competitors.positioning: Simple, cheap per-channel scheduler with a free AI Assistant, community inbox and Start Page.
competitors.audience: Solo creators, small businesses, small teams.

competitors.name: Hootsuite
competitors.pricing: Per user, shown on annual basis; currency not printed, FAQ uses $. Standard $99 (10 social accounts, 5 competitors), Professional $199 (unlimited accounts, 20 competitors, 30-day Quick Search, trend forecast 90 days), Advanced up to $399 (approvals, routing), Enterprise custom (Lumen listening 13 months, Parliament advocacy, SSO). Wisdom AI included on every plan.
competitors.positioning: Enterprise 'Social OS' (Perch publishing, Nest care, Parliament advocacy, Lumen listening) tied together by the Wisdom AI agent.
competitors.audience: Mid-market and enterprise social, care and comms teams.

competitors.name: Later
competitors.pricing: USD, billed yearly: Starter $18.75/mo (1 social set = 8 profiles, 1 user, 30 posts per profile, 5 AI credits), Growth $37.50/mo (2 sets, 2 users, 180 posts per profile, 50 AI credits), Scale $82.50/mo (6 sets, 4 users, unlimited posts, 100 AI credits, 20 competitors). Add-ons on Growth/Scale: social set $11.25/mo, user $3.75/mo, 100 AI credits $3.75/mo (help center says $5/mo or $40/yr). Monthly-billing price not captured.
competitors.positioning: Visual Instagram-first planner with Link in Bio, AI captions and creator tools.
competitors.audience: Creators, small brands, social managers focused on Instagram/TikTok.

competitors.name: Metricool
competitors.pricing: Free (1 brand, 20 posts/mo, 5 competitors, 5 AI credits per brand). Starter from $20/mo annual or $25 monthly (EUR 16/20) for 5 brands, $36/$45 for 10 brands, up to 100 competitors, 20 AI credits per brand. Advanced from $53/mo annual or $67 monthly (15 brands) up to $159/$210 (50 brands), approvals, team, API, 35 AI credits per brand. Custom: talk to sales. Add-ons: X $10/mo per account; Advanced Analytics from $12 (Starter) or $36 (Advanced) per month incl. Metricool Studio; Hashtag tracker $25/day. Prices exclude VAT.
competitors.positioning: Analytics-first planner priced per brand, with cheap competitor tracking and an AI analyst (Metricool Studio).
competitors.audience: Freelancers, agencies and SMBs managing several brands.

competitors.name: Sprout Social
competitors.pricing: Per seat per month, '$' shown: Essentials $79 annual ($99 monthly, 5 profiles), Standard $199 (5 profiles, inbox, collaboration), Professional $299 (unlimited profiles, competitor insights, Enhance Post), Advanced $399 (Enhance Reply, sentiment, API), Enterprise custom. 100 Trellis AI agent credits per seat per month. Add-ons: Premium Analytics, Listening, Employee Advocacy (Standard and up).
competitors.positioning: Premium all-in-one with Smart Inbox, deep reporting and the Trellis AI agent.
competitors.audience: Mid-market and enterprise marketing and care teams.

competitors.name: Planable
competitors.pricing: USD per workspace per month: Basic $33 (60 posts, 4 pages, approvals None/Optional), Pro $49 (150 posts, 10 pages, Required approvals, bulk approval, API), Enterprise custom (unlimited posts, Multi-level approvals, SSO). Unlimited users. Add-ons per workspace/month: Analytics $14 (cards say $12), Social inbox $9 ($7.50), Social listening $99 ($82.50; 1 brand, 3 topics). Yearly = 2 months free.
competitors.positioning: Collaboration and approval-first content planner for agencies and teams.
competitors.audience: Agencies, in-house teams with client or legal sign-off.

competitors.name: SocialBee
competitors.pricing: USD: Bootstrap $29/mo or $290/yr (5 accounts, 1 user, 1 workspace, 10 categories), Accelerate $49/mo or $490/yr (10 accounts, 50 categories, approvals), Pro $99/mo or $990/yr (25 accounts, 3 users, 5 workspaces). Agency Pro50/100/150: $179/$329/$449 monthly or $149/$274/$374 per month annual. Add-ons: user $10/mo, workspace $10/mo, 5 profiles $15/mo. 14-day trial, no card.
competitors.positioning: Category-based evergreen scheduler with an AI Copilot that writes your strategy.

competitors.name: Publer
competitors.pricing: Business starts at $10/mo for 1 social account and 1 user, yearly saves 20%, every 10th account and 10th member free (Publer help). Professional reported at $5/mo monthly or $4/mo yearly for the first account, Business $8/mo yearly (third-party; publer.com pricing page could not be fetched, so unverified). Free plan exists.
competitors.positioning: Low-cost per-account scheduler with strong automation (recycling, auto-delete, performance rules) and AI Assist.
competitors.audience: Freelancers, SMBs, agencies on a budget.

competitors.name: Vista Social
competitors.pricing: '$' shown: Professional $99/mo or $950/yr (15 profiles, 2 users, 10,000 DM contacts, 1,000 AI credits), Advanced $199/mo or $1,910/yr (30 profiles, 3 users, 25,000 DM contacts, 2,000 AI credits), Scale $449/mo or $4,310/yr (70 profiles, 4 users, 100,000 DM contacts, 3,500 AI credits), Enterprise custom. Listening $75 to $250 per listener per month. Employee advocacy $199/mo for 25 employees.
competitors.positioning: Feature-dense all-in-one with Ask Vista agent, DM automations, listening and reviews at mid-market prices.
competitors.audience: Agencies, multi-location brands, SMB marketing teams.

competitors.name: ContentStudio
competitors.pricing: '$' shown: Standard $29 monthly or $19/mo annual (5 accounts, 1 workspace, 25,000 AI words, 25 AI images, 100 AI video credits, 100 clipping credits), Advanced $69 or $49/mo annual (10 accounts, 2 workspaces, 2 users, inbox, approvals, competitor benchmark, 100 AI auto replies), Agency Unlimited $139 or $99/mo annual (25 accounts, unlimited workspaces and users), Enterprise custom, API plan $15/mo annual. Add-ons: listening $99/mo, extra account $5, user $10, workspace $10, white label $50/mo.
competitors.positioning: Agency-oriented suite with content discovery, AI Studio (text, image, video) and clip maker.
competitors.audience: Agencies and marketing teams handling several clients.

competitors.name: FeedHive
competitors.pricing: EUR: Creator 15/mo (4 accounts, 30 scheduled posts, 2.5K AI credits), Brand 22/mo (10 accounts, 5 workspaces, 500 scheduled), Business 69/mo (100 accounts, unlimited), Agency 239/mo (500 accounts). Annual billed 180/264/828/2868; page says yearly saves up to 30%. Launch bonus doubles AI credits for 3 months. 7-day trial.
competitors.positioning: AI-first creator scheduler with engagement prediction, conditional follow-ups, recycling suggestions and agent/CLI access.
competitors.audience: Creators, solo marketers, technical marketers using AI agents.

competitors.name: Postiz
competitors.pricing: '$' shown: Standard $29/mo ($23 annual, 5 channels, 3 AI videos, 60 clipping minutes), Team $39 ($31, 10 channels, team, 100 AI images), Pro $49 ($39, 30 channels), Ultimate $99 ($79, 100 channels). Unlimited posts. Open source (AGPL-3.0) and self-hostable.
competitors.positioning: Open-source scheduler for 30+ networks with an AI agent, MCP, CLI and API on every plan.

competitors.name: Predis.ai
competitors.pricing: '$' shown, annual pricing about 50% off list: Core $19/mo (list $32) or $230/yr, 1,300 credits, 1 brand, 10 channels, 60 competitor runs, no auto posting. Rise $40/mo (list $79) or $474/yr, 3,200 credits, 4 brands, 20 channels, 130 competitor runs, auto posting. Enterprise+ $212/mo (list $249) or $2,540/yr, 10,000 credits, unlimited brands, 60 channels, 600 competitor runs. 3-day trial, card required. Extra credits $29/mo.
competitors.positioning: AI ad and post generator (video, UGC avatars, statics, carousels) with competitor and ad intelligence plus scheduling.
competitors.audience: E-commerce brands, SMBs, agencies producing ads and posts at volume.

competitors.name: Ocoya
competitors.pricing: '$' shown, billed monthly + VAT: Starter $29/mo (1 user, 5 profiles, 300 credits), Team $79/mo (5 users, 20 profiles, 1,500 credits), Agency $199/mo (20 users, 100 profiles, 5,000 credits), Enterprise custom. Yearly = 2 months free. 7-day trial, card required. 1 credit per campaign post or article.
competitors.positioning: AI campaign generator plus Design Studio, workflows and publishing to social and CMS.

competitors.name: Blaze
competitors.pricing: '$' shown: Starter $79/mo (3 posting accounts, 600 credits, 1 user, one campaign planned a week ahead), Growth $149/mo (10 accounts, 1,500 credits, unlimited users, yearly planning window), All-In-One $999/mo flat done-for-you (ads, GBP, AI receptionist, reviews). AI video 15 credits each.
competitors.positioning: Autopilot marketing: scans your website, builds a brand kit and generates a weekly batch of posts to review.
competitors.audience: Small business owners with no marketer.

competitors.name: Simplified
competitors.pricing: USD: Starter $79/mo annual (page also lists $59 monthly, inconsistent), Pro $99/mo annual or $119 monthly, Business $199/mo annual or $239 monthly. Agent campaigns per month 5/15/40, $10 per extra campaign. Social accounts 7/15/30, brand kits 1/3/unlimited, seats -/3/7.
competitors.positioning: AI marketing team: Riley agent runs campaigns from a brief across writing, design, video and scheduling.
competitors.audience: SMBs, freelancers and agencies wanting campaign-level automation.

competitors.name: Agorapulse
competitors.pricing: Per user (currency not printed): Standard 99 monthly / 79 annual, Professional 149 / 119, Advanced 199 / 149, Custom by sales; each plan includes 10 social profiles shared across users. Free 'Archie plan': Archie AI studio only, 10 credits/mo, up to 50 FB/IG/LinkedIn/YouTube profiles. 15-day trial (Advanced). agorapulse.com pages returned empty, figures are from the help center.
competitors.positioning: Inbox-strong suite for agencies, now adding Archie, an AI studio that repurposes sources and top posts into drafts.
competitors.audience: Agencies, community managers, SMB and mid-market teams.

features.detail: Opens inside the post composer and the Create (Ideas) space. Input: a text prompt or the existing post text. Actions: generate, rephrase, shorten, expand, refine; switch to 'more casual' or 'more formal' tone; repurpose one post into multiple formats; 'customize the post for each social media network'; summarize long content into short posts. Tailors for LinkedIn, Threads, X, Instagram, Bluesky.
features.limits_or_cost: Free on every plan, no stated limits. Prompt text is sent to OpenAI (not account data or media).
features.notable: AI is opt-in per post; one-click per-network tailoring of the same idea.

features.feature: Ideas board with AI idea generation
features.detail: An 'Ideas' library (board view, tags, drafts, templates) where users save content ideas; the AI Assistant in Ideas generates new post ideas when you are 'out of ideas'. Ideas can later be turned into scheduled posts.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: 100 ideas, 3 tags. Paid: unlimited ideas, 250 tags.
features.notable: Backlog of ideas separate from the queue keeps planning and publishing decoupled.

features.detail: Browser extension lets users save web content (articles, inspiration) into Ideas or directly into the queue.

Each channel gets recurring posting times in its own time zone. When scheduling, options are 'Next Available', 'Prioritize' (move to top of queue), 'Now', 'Set Date and Time'. Posts drop into the next open slot.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: 10 scheduled posts per channel. Paid: unlimited with 5,000 per channel fair-use cap.
features.notable: Slot-based queue means users never pick a time; 'Prioritize' handles urgent posts.

features.detail: All channels in one grid, week and month views, filter by channel, tag or post type, drag to reschedule, edit in place. Drafts on all plans.

Composer shows a separate text box per network; caption, hashtags, link and time can be customized per platform; each version becomes its own post in that channel's queue. Includes custom video covers (paid), link shortening, duplicate posts, channel groups (paid).
Schedule a first comment with the post, e.g. to hold hashtags so the caption stays clean.

Publishes to 12 channels: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, Google Business Profile, Mastodon, Substack Notes, X, plus Start Page. The publish page says FB Pages, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest and GBP publish automatically; for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and FB Groups formats it sends a reminder notification so the user finishes in the app (which IG/TikTok formats need this is not detailed: partly unverified).
features.notable: Reminder mode as a fallback where APIs do not allow auto-publish.

features.detail: Compose X threads (and Threads) as multiple posts in the composer, preview, schedule; Buffer publishes each in order.
Saved hashtag groups insertable into posts.

Comment management for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, X, TikTok, GBP, YouTube, Mastodon. Reply in Buffer or jump to the native app; web and mobile. 'Filters & sorting': unanswered, newest, oldest, date ranges. Notifications on new comments. Saved replies. AI replies draft in your style with rephrase, shorten, expand.
features.limits_or_cost: Included on all plans. AI replies: 5 suggestions per week free, unlimited paid. Saved replies: 1 free, unlimited paid.

features.detail: Score that tracks response rate, response speed and consistency of replying, framed as 'consistency, speed, and engagement habits'.
features.notable: Gamifies community management with one number.

features.detail: Button 'Create post from reply' turns a comment reply into its own new post. Comment insights (surfacing themes and ideas from replies) is marked 'Coming soon'.
features.notable: Turns audience conversations into content; a cheap remix source that needs no competitor data.

features.detail: Analytics for 11 networks (likes, comments, impressions, new followers, reach, engagement, top posts, period change). 'Takeaways' turn results into one-click actions: 'Revise Posting Schedule' -> 'Adjust Your Schedule'; 'Boost Posting Frequency' (behind posting goal) -> 'Create a Post'; 'Repost Your Engaging Content' -> 'View Post Details'.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: 30-day history. Performance overview, custom analytics, reports, UTM: Essentials+. Branded reports: Team.
features.notable: Every insight ends in a button that starts the fix, including reposting a winner.

features.detail: All Channels report with top posts, followers chart, export menu; single-channel views; PDF and CSV export; branded reports.
features.limits_or_cost: PDF/CSV on paid plans; branded reports Team only.

features.detail: Link-in-bio page builder: embed videos, feature latest posts, showcase products, collect emails, add photos and forms; themes, colors, fonts, 14 layout templates. Built-in analytics: page views, custom link clicks, social link clicks. Can be published to like a channel.
features.limits_or_cost: Free forever with some limits; custom domain not mentioned.

features.detail: Approval workflows plus 'Custom access and permissions'; internal Notes on posts (Essentials+).

Integrations: Bitly, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Dropbox, Google Drive and Photos, IFTTT, Make, n8n, OneDrive, Perplexity, Raycast, Unsplash, WordPress, Zapier. Public API and an MCP server so Claude or ChatGPT can query performance data.
features.limits_or_cost: API keys 1/3/5; requests per 30 days 3,000 / 7,500 / 15,000 by plan.

features.detail: Chat agent ('Hootsuite's social-first AI agent'; replaced Yeti and OwlyGPT). Drafts social posts, campaign ideas, content briefs, images and captions for review. Analyses trends, risks, competitor activity, performance and review feedback. Cards: 'Predict trends', 'Recommend next steps', 'Spot risks early'. Example actions: 'draft a post, flag a negative comment, share a report'. Connected to Lumen (listening) and Perch (planning); Nest and Parliament 'Coming Soon'. Launched 24 Jun 2026 with MCP connectors for Perch, Nest and Lumen.
features.notable: One conversation goes from signal (trend, risk) to drafted post to next step.

features.detail: AI identifies your best-performing organic posts and rewrites them into new versions 'without duplicating it'; launched in 2023 as OwlyWriter AI, now listed under analytics AI recommendations.
features.limits_or_cost: Listed as a Pro (Professional) plan feature on the analytics page.
features.notable: Your own winners as the remix source: proven and brand-safe.

features.feature: Create: remix past posts and image-to-post
features.detail: AI content creation in Composer: 'Create from scratch, remix past posts, or turn images into content'; generate posts and on-brand images for any network; Wisdom creates visuals that match a caption.
Generates captions and hashtags for every network, with an ideas engine for post suggestions. Hashtag generator tags content based on copy, images and videos.
features.notable: Hashtags inferred from the media, not only the caption.

features.detail: Trend discovery searches brand mentions and trending topics by industry, topic, company or hashtag; results can be turned into AI-generated posts. Wisdom shows a quick search panel with trending topics and search percentages; Professional plan forecasts social trends up to 90 days ahead.

features.feature: Best time to post heat map
features.detail: Recommended publishing times shown in the calendar window and as a heat map (e.g. 'Tuesday 15:00 slot'); choose a goal: increase engagement, drive traffic, build awareness or extend reach; schedule to auto-publish at the recommended time.
features.notable: Goal-specific best times rather than one generic slot.

features.detail: Schedule 'up to 350 posts at once'; suspend all scheduled posts in a crisis or for an unexpected opportunity.
features.limits_or_cost: CSV import not described on the page.
features.notable: Global pause button is a compliance safety valve.

features.detail: Calendar or list view of organic and paid, published and scheduled content; map campaigns and fill content gaps.

Instagram feed, Reels, Stories, carousels up to 20 photos (Business account); TikTok toggles for comments, Duets, Stitches; Bluesky 300 chars, 4 images or 1 GIF or 1 video; X character-limit warnings; Threads on all plans.

Watchlist built by searching competitor usernames. Metrics: number of posts, posting frequency, average engagement, audience growth, follower count, estimated engagement, average post length, average hashtags per post. Industry benchmarking by vertical and company size. Sentiment and share of voice (incl. LLM visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) via listening.
features.limits_or_cost: Standard: 5 competitors. Professional/Advanced: 20. Real-time alerts Enterprise only.

features.detail: View competitors' top-performing posts ranked by 'likes, comments, replies, engagement, and more'; track the hashtags used in those posts.
features.notable: Ranked competitor post feed is the raw material for remixing.

features.feature: Social performance score and AI recommendations
features.detail: Weekly or monthly score across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn with a snapshot of the most and least engaging posts of the past week; 'AI recommendations and highlights' give tips to raise the score.

Pre-defined templates; drill down to post, network or page; paid and organic side by side; export .csv, .xlsx, .pdf, .ppt; share with external emails. Custom and scheduled reports on Professional. Advanced Analytics (Enterprise add-on) adds ROI, custom metrics and rule-based tags.
features.limits_or_cost: Instagram data can take up to 64 hours to appear.

features.detail: Track mentions, keywords, hashtags; sentiment over time; real-time alerts on sentiment shifts; 50+ saved Boolean searches; custom dashboards; AI summaries. Basic listening on all plans; advanced (13 months history) on Enterprise.
features.limits_or_cost: Quick Search 30-day on Professional; Lumen advanced Enterprise only.

features.detail: Comments and DMs from Facebook, Instagram, X, WhatsApp, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads. Saved replies, auto-responders, 'Reply with AI' suggestions to review, assignment, skill-based routing, AI classifiers that auto-route, agent status 'available'/'away', 'Boomerang messages', internal notes and agent chat, PII masking, SLA alerts, CSAT surveys.
features.limits_or_cost: Unified inbox on every plan; Advanced Inbox add-on (Enterprise) adds sentiment, 60+ language detection.

features.detail: Comment trigger: when someone comments a keyword on your post they get a DM. Multiple comment-reply variations; delay replies by a few minutes so they feel personal.
features.limits_or_cost: Inbox automation listed on Professional and above.
features.notable: Keyword-comment-to-DM is the standard lead-capture loop.

features.detail: Answers questions across social and website using FAQs you approve, hands off to humans with a conversation summary; claims up to 80% of replies automated.
features.notable: Answers only from approved FAQs: useful pattern for regulated advisers.

features.detail: Custom approval workflows tailored to teams; 'review and approve content with your team'.
Canva and Adobe Express templates inside Composer; free stock images; 100+ integrations; MCP connectors so ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini can reach Hootsuite data.
Customizable link page created and managed from the Hootsuite dashboard.
Employee advocacy product (formerly Amplify) for sharing approved brand content through staff.
features.notable: Pre-approved library staff can share: relevant to adviser networks.

features.feature: Visual planner with Instagram feed preview
features.detail: Calendar plus grid preview: 'Preview your feed before it goes live'; 'Drag, drop, and rearrange posts until your feed looks exactly how you want it.'

Schedule to 'up to 10 social profiles at once' with per-profile customization for each network's media rules. Networks: Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat.
features.limits_or_cost: Posts per profile: 30 Starter, 180 Growth, unlimited Scale.

features.detail: Recommends times from past posts, follower activity and industry trends, highlighted in the calendar; auto-enabled when the profile is eligible.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter: IG, FB, TikTok. Growth+: 'Multi-Profile Best Times to Post'.

features.detail: Input: a few keywords describing the post. Output: multiple caption options to edit; learns brand tone from past posts; regenerate with a different tone or phrasing (returns 3 new versions).
Generates content pillars (free), then post ideas within each pillar for planning the calendar.
features.limits_or_cost: Ideas cost 1 credit per batch of 3; first 3 ideas per pillar free. Beta, desktop only.
features.notable: Pillar-first ideation keeps output on-strategy.

features.detail: One shared monthly pool for all AI features: Starter 5, Growth 50, Scale 100; resets 1st of month 00:00 UTC.
features.limits_or_cost: Add-on 100 credits: $3.75/mo on pricing page; help center says $5/mo or $40/yr.

features.detail: Mini web page for Instagram, TikTok and Snap: clickable feed posts (only posts tagged with a link appear), custom buttons, featured banner, Mailchimp signup, custom affiliate links, link analytics, custom SEO title/meta, personalized URL, Linktree import.
features.limits_or_cost: Multiple links per IG post (up to 5) on Growth and above. TikTok links need Business account with 1,000+ followers.
features.notable: Shoppable grid that mirrors the feed.

features.feature: Collect UGC by tags and mentions
features.detail: 'Collect by Tags' and 'Collect by Mentions' pull user-generated content into the media library (which also takes uploads, Canva, Dropbox).
Compare against competitors; plus 'Brand Health' and 'Brand Mentions' monitoring. Metrics and top-post display not described on the public page.

Reach, engagement rate, follower growth for IG, FB, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads. 'Custom Analytics' picks metrics, ranges, platforms, post type; 'Campaign Tagging' groups posts into a campaign total; Meta Ads Analytics.
features.limits_or_cost: History: 3 months Starter, 1 year Growth, 2 years Scale. Custom Analytics and Meta Ads Scale only. Audience analytics needs 100+ followers.

features.detail: Conversations from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok in one inbox.
'Content Approval Workflow' and 'External Comment Workflow' for outside reviewers; 'Share Calendar' and 'Calendar Notes'; Access Groups and custom roles.
Tag products in scheduled Instagram posts.

Add competitor profiles and see 'Followers and Likes', 'Posts' (browse recent content for style, frequency, topics), 'Interactions' (likes, comments, shares) and 'Extra Stats'. Networks: Facebook, Instagram, Bluesky, Twitch; YouTube and X with add-on.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: 5 competitors. Starter and above: up to 100.
features.notable: 100 competitors on a $20 plan is far cheaper than enterprise tools.

features.detail: Within competitor analysis, browse a competitor's recent posts in one place to study style, frequency and topics. Sorting by engagement is not described (unverified).

Generates captions, hashtags, emojis, brainstormed ideas; adapts a post per network; changes tone; translates; fixes spelling; adds CTAs; shortens or lengthens. Returns one post that you refine with shortcuts (not 5 options). AI Alt Text Generator also uses credits.
features.limits_or_cost: Credits per brand per month: Free 5, Starter 20, Advanced 35, Custom configurable. Per-action cost not published.

features.detail: Brand settings > AI configuration holds general instructions plus per-network instructions (shown only for connected networks; instructions for disconnected networks are kept hidden).
features.notable: Per-network voice rules, e.g. LinkedIn formal and Instagram casual.

features.detail: Built-in AI assistant (reported as Claude-powered) for analytics, reporting and planning. 'Explore insights' button above Analytics tables offers questions (best/worst content, recurring patterns, top format, change vs previous period) and opens the answer view. Top content cards show thumbnail, title, engagement, views, reach, saves. Expert mode has a prompt helper bar that turns each element (brand, networks, period, chart or text type) green as you type.
features.limits_or_cost: Part of the Advanced Analytics add-on (from $12/mo Starter, $36/mo Advanced); was free for a limited time in May 2026.
features.notable: Pre-written questions on top of every table remove the blank-prompt problem.

features.feature: Planner with best times and feed preview
features.detail: Drag-and-drop calendar for Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, GBP, Twitch, LinkedIn (paid). Best time to post for IG, FB, TikTok, X, YouTube. Instagram feed preview. Saved texts for common phrases. Schedule polls and PDFs on paid plans. Up to 35 images per Facebook post.
features.limits_or_cost: Free plan posts per month: 20 on pricing page, 50 on planner article (inconsistent).

features.detail: Lists of evergreen posts that are recycled and republished automatically on a schedule.
Recurring scheduling redesigned with 'Step by step' and 'Prompt from scratch' tabs; settings carry over between tabs.
features.notable: Describe a recurrence in plain language instead of form fields.

features.detail: 'Duplicate to other brands' copies a post across brands; when a target brand lacks the network you can skip it (default) or include it anyway. 'Repurpose posts between brands' listed on paid plans.
Library has a board view with one column per status; drag cards (Ctrl/Cmd to multi-move) to change status; changes logged in post history; assign posts to team members.
features.limits_or_cost: Library holds 250 posts per brand on every plan (up from 50).

features.detail: Post approval system; reviewers in the approval portal can comment on any post, approved or not, in real time ('Comments without rejecting').
Selector to mark posts as AI-generated for Instagram (image, reel, carousel), TikTok Business and YouTube.
features.notable: Disclosure toggle at post level.

features.detail: 'Planning' > 'Flows' > '+ New Flow'. Instagram templates: 'Turn comments into direct messages' (any comment or keyword -> DM with message or link, optional public reply and message sequence), 'Reply to direct messages with keywords' (text, button, link), 'Turn story replies into direct messages'. TikTok templates: 'Moderate your video comments' (hide banned words), 'Reply to comments right away', 'DM to DM'. Optional delays, mobile preview, draft or on.
features.limits_or_cost: Up to 3 reply variants rotated at random; delays up to 24 hours. Starter and above (third-party tracker); IG needs professional account + linked FB page.
features.notable: Random reply variants avoid spammy identical replies.

features.detail: Inbox for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, GBP on all plans; X with add-on; LinkedIn on paid. Rich text notes.

Customizable microsite: multiple links, buttons, images, videos, posts; colors and templates; custom URL; analytics for visits, clicks and CTR with reordering by performance. Multiple link-in-bio pages.
features.limits_or_cost: Unlimited links and analytics on paid plans.

features.detail: Automated PDF/PPT reports, monthly auto-send, live URL sharing; customizable templates and Looker Studio connector on Advanced. Campaign dashboards combine organic and Google/Meta/TikTok Ads; 'View posts' opens every post, reel and story with per-network tabs, filters, sorting.
features.limits_or_cost: 3 dashboards included, unlimited with Advanced Analytics add-on.

features.detail: Tracks a hashtag's reach and posts on Instagram (and X on paid plans).
Metricool MCP on all plans (limits on Free/Starter); API, Zapier, Make on Advanced; Canva and Google Drive on Starter+; Adobe Express on all.

Agent across Listening, Publishing, Smart Inbox and Reporting. Turns performance data into executive-ready summaries, flags unusual spikes in volume or sentiment, compares performance across networks, runs sentiment and theme analysis and routes it to teams; synthesizes 'viral trends and competitor themes'.
features.limits_or_cost: Every plan since July 2026; 100 AI agent credits per seat per month. Overage terms unpublished.

features.detail: Teams build customizable AI skill templates; recurring tasks run automatically, e.g. track a viral trend or summarize a week of feedback.
features.notable: User-defined recurring agent jobs.

features.detail: 'Enhance Post by AI Assist' in the composer plus AI caption suggestions and alt text generation.
AI improves drafted replies in the Smart Inbox.
Recommends posting times from about 16 weeks of audience data; Sprout cites up to 60% reach lift.

Plan and schedule across profiles in a shared calendar; send posts to outside stakeholders for approval. Sprout Campaigns plans, executes and measures campaigns; content can be pushed in from project tools.
Guide internal and external team members through approving messages; supports 'unanimous approval'.

Plans, writes, designs and schedules every week: produces 'a weekly batch of visual, text, and video content' and a content calendar to review; edit text, visuals, media anytime; 'Blaze Brain' learns from your edits and post performance; automatic generation can be switched on or off.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter one campaign planned one week ahead; Growth multiple campaigns months ahead.
features.notable: Default-on generation with a review window flips the user from creator to editor.

features.detail: Onboarding asks for your website URL; Blaze scans it and creates a starting Brand Kit: 'Media Library', 'Brand Styles', 'Brand Voice', 'Brand Profile' (business, offerings, audience), 'Source Materials' (PDFs, brand guides, product sheets).
features.notable: One input (URL) produces a usable brand profile.

features.detail: Market location, target audience, who appears in content, image and video use (e.g. 'Brand Kit Only'), logo frequency, default CTAs, hashtags, blog and email formatting, words or phrases to avoid.
Campaigns define goal, posting frequency, content volume and channels; 'Edit Schedule & Channels' adjusts one campaign (e.g. more posts for a launch).
Content Plan > 'Adjust Defaults': 'Default Schedule' (when Blaze posts per channel and how many days before posting you want to review) and 'Default Channels' (platforms and volume per channel).
features.notable: Explicit review lead time before auto-posting.

features.detail: Animates a Brand Kit image into a short video with Google Veo 3; enabled in Content Preferences 'Video' tab; Blaze adds an equal share of each selected video type to each weekly batch; regenerate creates a new version.
features.limits_or_cost: 15 credits per video (and per regeneration). No style selection.

features.detail: 'Improve' feature to refine a post; regenerate or bulk edit posts; generate in other languages; add and edit audio.
'Crosspost' sends the same content to all accounts without resizing; calendar list, week, 5-day views; 'Review and approve before publishing'.
Performance shows in 'Insights' after a few business days and feeds the next plan ('Blaze Learning Loop').
Flat-rate service: marketing funnel, GBP, Google and GMB search ads, AI visibility, AI receptionist, inbound lead qualification, automated reviews, reporting.

'Start with Riley': brief with goal, audience, offer, channels and brand rules; Riley uses the Brand Kit and connected tools and returns creative, captions and scheduling queued for approval, then reports results and suggests next steps. Agency example: 'Client brief' -> 'Brand voice checked' -> 'Approval route sent to client' -> '42 posts queued by market'.
features.limits_or_cost: Campaigns per month 5 / 15 / 40; $10 per extra campaign; no rollover.

features.detail: Colors, fonts, voice, products, customers and approved examples; 'Brandbook' per client; BrandVoice matches a client's voice.
features.notable: Approved examples as part of the brand kit.

features.detail: Writing, design (e.g. 3 branded sizes) and video (e.g. UGC-style product video) available standalone and as campaign assets.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter: 100K words, 100 designs, 50 videos; Pro/Business unlimited.

features.detail: 'Client Review' bundles a campaign's drafts into one link and collects approve, reject and comment per post with no login; approved content moves into scheduling. Nothing publishes without approval unless auto-publish is on.
'Private TeamSpaces' per client, 'User Roles', branded 'Client Portal' showing upcoming content, reviews and status; 'Shared Calendars'; 'Custom Reports'.
Approved posts go to each channel with schedule, format and campaign context; 'Scheduled tasks' repeat daily, weekly or monthly; bulk scheduling on Business.

OAuth MCP at apikit.simplified.com/mcp with 105 tools: scheduling on 13 platforms with timed auto-comments, image and video generation, brand kits, projects with review gates, analytics, approval links, media editing. Claude Code plugin adds 14 skills.
features.limits_or_cost: Connector free (MIT); free plan 3 accounts and 10 posts per month.

features.detail: Workflow route: Archie > 'New conversation' > 'Use top performing posts' > pick profile and Playbook > 'Show my 20 top posts' > filter 'Period' (default Last 3 months) and 'Sort' (Engagement, Views, Reach, Clicks, Engagement rate) > 'Repurpose' on a post > choose target profiles and versions per profile > 'Generate drafts'. Playbook route: 'Top performing posts' with periods Last month/3 months/6 months/Last year and 'Rank by' incl. Saves, then 'Reuse this post'. Output: original drafts sharing the source's theme and format.
features.limits_or_cost: Max 5 generated posts per profile; video posts excluded.
features.notable: The cleanest documented 'remix my winners' flow in the category.

features.detail: No blank composer: every workflow starts from a source: 'PDF', 'URL', 'Video' (MP4/MOV/WebM, 2 GB), 'Audio' (MP3/WAV/M4A, 500 MB), 'Video Clips'. Archie extracts Ideas; click 'Draft' (or @Reference); it proposes four angles with +/- drafts per angle (max 5); 'Generate draft' for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram; each profile gets its own adapted post in 'Drafts'. Refine by typing feedback after '@'.
features.limits_or_cost: Archie on all plans; free Archie plan has 10 credits/mo.
features.notable: Source -> ideas -> angles -> per-network drafts gives structure to repurposing.

features.detail: Sources tab: 'Trim' a clip, select clips, 'Generate posts from clip', aspect ratio 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 4:3, 'Subtitle style' ('No subtitles', 'Karaoke', 'Simple'); 'Edit clip' for ratio, style presets, font, effects, transcript.

'Generate an image' after a text post: 'References' (upload; 'Layout', 'Blend', 'Style only'), 'Type' ('Visual hook', 'Infographic', 'Illustration'), 'Text in image', 'Branding', 'Style' (e.g. 'Tech Minimal', 'Corporate', 'Photoreal'), 'Format', up to 4 outputs. Review prompt in 'Fields' or 'Full prompt'. Edit tab: 'Crop', 'Add text', 'Add image', describe-and-'Redraw'.
features.notable: Reference image with Layout/Blend/Style-only modes = visual remix control.

features.detail: Brand goal, target audience, tone, CTA links (used for auto first comments on Facebook and LinkedIn), logo and brand colors for images; edit 'Audience and Goals' or 'Call to Action'.
features.notable: CTA link stored once, auto-placed as first comment.

features.detail: Outputs for LinkedIn (text, image, short video), Facebook (text, image, Reels), Instagram (Reels, image), YouTube (video, Shorts), TikTok (video, photo); X and Threads planned. Free 'Archie plan': 1 owner + up to 100 Archie-only users, 50 FB/IG/LinkedIn/YouTube profiles, 10 credits/mo, Publishing Calendar and Drafts; new posts only via Archie.
features.limits_or_cost: Credit usage not tracked during beta.
features.notable: Free AI-only tier as a funnel into the paid suite.

features.detail: In Composer. 'Empty Mode' (prompt, 'Send Prompt') or 'Normal Mode' on a draft with quick actions 'Shorter', 'Longer', 'Rephrase', 'Translate in...', tones Promotional, Engaging, Catchy, Inspirational, Assertive, Funny, Shocking; 'Enter your own prompt'; results 'Send to Composer', 'Copy', 'Retry'.

Organization settings > AI Configuration > 'Configure your AI Context': company website, industry, brand type, competitors, tone of voice, advanced instructions -> 'Generate context' (editable). Suggested sections: Organization Profile, Tone & Style, Constraints & Policies (always/never rules), Glossary. Overrides custom prompts; 'Disable Context' per session. Used by Writing Assistant and AI report summaries.
features.notable: Org-wide always/never rules are a natural home for compliance constraints.

features.detail: Single report: 'AI insights' > 'Summarize' -> 'Profile performance summary', 'Content Analysis', 'Actionable Recommendations'. Report Studio: 'Key Findings', 'Trends & Correlations', 'Strategic Recommendations'. Per-metric breakdown via purple star. Optional inclusion in PDF export.
features.limits_or_cost: Single reports all paid plans; Report Studio Advanced/Custom. Analyses 50 posts (25 newest, 25 oldest); not in scheduled exports.

features.detail: 'Manage competitors' > '+ Add competitor' (Facebook page URL or Instagram username). Sections: 'Competitors benchmark' (followers, posts, total and average engagement), 'Top content' (6 best posts across all profiles, sort by Likes, Comments, Shares, Engagement), 'Audience', 'Publishing' (Reels, Carousels, Videos, Photos, Links, Texts), 'Engagement per post type', 'Engagement'. PDF export emailed.
features.limits_or_cost: Instagram (Professional/Business only) and Facebook. Included competitors: Standard 1, Professional 1, Advanced 6; more via add-on. Post data backfills 30 days; no Stories or FB Reels.

features.detail: Rules per profile. Conditions: 'Text includes keywords', 'Text contains only mentions', 'only emojis', 'a link', 'an email', 'Text word count', 'Language' (18), 'Inbox item type', 'Post is labeled'. Actions (up to 6): 'Review', 'Assign', 'Label', 'Hide', 'Delete', 'Ban sender', 'Apply sentiment'. Priority resolves conflicts.
features.limits_or_cost: One rule on Standard/Professional/Advanced; unlimited rules and multi-condition on Custom.
features.notable: Auto-hide comments with links or emails: a compliance guardrail.

features.detail: Reply, assign and review, labels, saved replies, sentiment tracking, hide/delete, search/filter/sort, bulk actions, export, filter presets, custom inboxes, 'Inbox Approval Workflows' for replies, ad comment management.
features.notable: Approval on replies, not only posts.

features.detail: Report Studio with widget library, folders and export; Social Media ROI dashboards tracking traffic from Pulse.ly links vs GA4 (details not captured: unverified); Meta and LinkedIn Ads reports.
MCP integration for external AI agents; Zapier.
